policy.intakeOverwrite: refuse unless existing and incoming SHA-256 hashes are identical
policy.derivativeOverwrite: refuse unless existing and generated SHA-256 hashes are identical
policy.sourceFiles: unchanged GLB copies under docs/art/source; Downloads is read only when an explicit --stage-from folder is passed
policy.geometry: preserve positions, normals, UVs, indices and triangle count; no decimation, quantization or Meshopt transform
policy.textures: retain and resize base-color only; remove normal and metallic-roughness maps because the item toon renderer ignores them; WebP quality 90, desktop max 512px, mobile max 256px
policy.materials: preserve base-color, emissive and alpha factors exactly; preserve the base-color image pixel values apart from resize and WebP encoding; no recolor or rebake
policy.visualStyle: preserve the authored hand-painted, Borderlands-inspired target with in-game toon shading; this pipeline does not repaint PBR imagery or claim visual acceptance

entries.unsupportedExtensionPolicy: KHR_materials_volume registered and preserved when present; FB_ngon_encoding has declaration only and no payload in these sources, so the optional declaration is dropped; any other extension payload fails closed.

orientationAnalysis.localBoundsSourceUnits: glTF POSITION accessors; no node transforms applied
orientationAnalysis.ambiguity: PCA sign cannot identify which end is the wrapped torch head; confirm top direction in the browser fixture before applying a rotation.
